free_text: The decision to recommend a biopsy is supported by the high PSA level of 15.0 ng/mL and the PI-RADS 5 finding, which indicate a high likelihood of prostate cancer. Furthermore, the prior positive biopsy (bx) necessitates re-evaluation of the disease status. Given the severe LUTS (IPSS 27/35) and other risk factors, a biopsy is warranted to guide further management.
